default.description: Default capability for TimeWrite main and feature windows

sub-windows-minimal.description: Minimal capability for read-mostly side windows: debug console / diary-book viewer / AI toolbox (core event APIs only, no fs/dialog/shell)

updater-main-only.description: Tauri updater permission for the main window only (settings page checks/downloads/installs updates). Feature windows never expose update UI, so they must not receive download-and-install rights.
